title: Ancient temples dismantled and items removed
summary: Matt tells of Ancient temples dismantled and items removed, about unspecified at Lake Van region, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: certain ancient temples that have been dismantled and things that have been removed and I have found very very compelling evidence that that it's happened

plain: A researcher known as Matt, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, says that certain ancient temples in the Lake Van region of eastern Turkey were taken apart and that things were removed from them. He says he has found very, very compelling evidence that this happened, though he does not name a source. If he is right, someone deliberately hid part of the region's ancient past.
